title: Show, don't deck
summary: Why Showmob exists: ideas as living pages instead of hand-built slide decks.

blocks.title: Show, don't deck
blocks.body: Present ideas as living pages instead of slide decks: links, motion, light interactivity, one URL to share.

blocks.quote: A helpful communication tool: publish a link, let anyone open it, and require no account to view.

blocks.heading: Why this exists
blocks.body: Every hand-built deck is a one-off. The useful parts - structure, style, and widgets - should be reusable, so a new idea gets assembled rather than rebuilt. Showmob is an active side project that aims to make one-off decks unnecessary.

blocks.title: Where this stands
blocks.body: Active-development side project. The prototype moves quickly, keeps its content portable, and uses version history to make changes reversible.

blocks.title: Public product brief
blocks.body: This page states the product rationale and the content-contract boundary without linking to private planning material.

blocks.heading: The one early invariant
blocks.body: Everything else can change. The content contract - one schema, JSON blocks referencing widgets by id - cannot. That is part 2.
